items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Gee, is it two years since Forbes died? Huh? It doesn't seem like two years since Forbes died.

ctx.x: He said he didn't know where he was located. I don't know if he's dead or what.
Gee, is it two years since Forbes died? Huh? It doesn't seem like two years since Forbes died. No, I didn't say two years.
